intro: Work the stages in order. The story cannot be rushed past — chapters and missions unlock in sequence — so do the story first, then the side strands, then sweep Leonida for collectibles, then grind the activities, then the combat and money trophies, and finish with the 100% cleanup that unlocks the platinum.

stages.goal: Finish the story and earn every story trophy, including the gold for the final mission.
stages.note: Story missions unlock in order and can be replayed, so none of them is missable. The choice trophy and the partnership trophy live in this stage — engage with choice moments as they appear.
stages.title: Play the story: Chapters 1–4 and the finale

stages.goal: Close every side character chain and 8 stranger strands for the silver.
stages.note: Side strands unlock as the story progresses. Clear each character's icon when it appears rather than leaving the whole strand for the end.
stages.title: Side missions and strangers

stages.goal: Sweep Leonida region by region for cards, meditation spots, WAiNK locations, vehicles and garages, and visit every area.
stages.note: These are the map-sweep trophies. Doing them together saves hours: one pass through a district clears cards, spots, WAiNK locations and new vehicles at once.
stages.title: Collectibles and exploration

stages.goal: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win races and drone races, fish, bowl and finish 50 challenges.
stages.note: The Shooting Range golds are the longest grind in this stage. Start them early and chip away between story missions.
stages.title: Activities and challenges

stages.goal: Bank vaults, armored trucks, gang operations, Combat Focus and the money trophies.
stages.note: Most of these are repeatable, but the partner trophies, the stealth jewelry robbery and the showroom stunt need a specific setup — read their missable notes first.
stages.title: Combat, robberies and money

stages.goal: Use the in-game completion stats as the master list, clear the last categories, and the platinum pops.
stages.note: 100% completion is its own gold trophy and the last gate before the platinum. Check the tracker here: 54 of 54 means the platinum is next.
stages.title: 100% cleanup and the platinum
